findings.text: follow-on: the bulk marking call at the end of ingest_pages is wrapped in a bare `except Exception: logger.warning(...)` (pipeline.py:1558-1561), so any exception in mark_dynamic_handbook_pages is swallowed and the run still reports 'Ingestion complete'. A fail-open guard for exactly the behaviour this node exists to guarantee: a fresh ingest that raises during marking leaves pages unmarked with no failure surfaced to the caller. Reproduced shape: the try/except covers the whole marking step; nothing records that it did not run.

follow-on: TestDatabaseMergeGraph EXPLAINs a hand-copied duplicate of the production merge statement (tests/wiki/test_pipeline.py:485-495) rather than the statement link_chunks_to_entities actually runs (pipeline.py:585-600). The two are identical today, so the test passes, but if the production Cypher changes the test keeps EXPLAINing the stale copy and would not catch a new syntax error or parameter. The gate proves a copy of the statement parses, not the statement.

follow-on: mark_dynamic_handbook_pages sets p.fronts_database (pipeline.py:451) but never sets p.status, so jt-60sa:CategoryInformation2 is marked while carrying status 'skipped' (live Cypher), not the 'ingested' the plan designs for a dynamic page so its chunk anchors the edges. Harmless against the current read path (_fetch_wiki_page matches by id/url/title without a status filter), but the plan's stated invariant does not hold for the third table and any future status-filtered read would drop it.

follow-on: ingest_page now runs a facility-wide WikiChunk scan (WHERE c.text CONTAINS '?db=') once per page (pipeline.py:1250-1252) to resolve the databases a page fronts, so a batch ingest costs O(pages x facility chunks) with a CONTAINS scan each time. The linking set is facility-invariant within a batch and could be fetched once in ingest_pages and passed down. Not a correctness defect.

follow-on: mark_dynamic_handbook_pages builds its topic set only from linking chunk texts (pipeline.py:420-427), not from a page's own form, so a dynamic page whose body names its database but which no sibling ?db= link reaches is marked only if its own ingest ran the ingest_page fallback (_dynamic_page_databases). A page whose ingest was skipped and which has no inbound link would stay unmarked by the bulk pass. Latent; every jt-60sa table is reached by an inbound link today.

justifications.durability: The added tests are focused (TestIngestMarksDynamicPage, TestMarkDynamicHandbookPages, TestDatabaseMergeGraph) and the negative control is a real reproduced red, not a passing suite standing in for a guard. Loses points because the graph test EXPLAINs a hand-copied duplicate of the production merge statement (tests/wiki/test_pipeline.py:485), so a change to link_chunks_to_entities would not move the test; because the bulk marking is wrapped in a broad try/except that logs and continues (pipeline.py:1560-1561), so a marking failure leaves ingest reporting success with pages unmarked; and because the bulk pass derives topics only from linking chunks, not a page's own form, so a skipped page with no inbound ?db= link stays unmarked.
justifications.evidence: Gate arms reproduced independently in scratch trees over the reviewed run's own surface: base c323401f9 103 passed EXIT=0 (arm-base.log), head 49304d164 105 passed EXIT=0 (arm-head.log). The live-graph EXPLAIN test reproduces (1 passed EXIT=0, arm-graph.log). The negative control reproduces: removing the detector condition from ingest_page reds TestIngestMarksDynamicPage::test_ingest_marks_dynamic_page with EXIT=1 (arm-neg.log). A bounded live query confirms the marking and 6298 distinct FacilitySignals reached through DOCUMENTS from the marked chunks, and 3 stub chunks carrying an embedding. Loses points because the stub-chunk embedding is evidenced by a Cypher count rather than an end-to-end embed of a newly created chunk, and the fragment carries no figure.
justifications.fit: The change reuses the existing WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal linkage and the existing link_chunks_to_entities writer; no new edge or property is added (fronts_database already existed), WikiPageStatus is not widened, and apply_dynamic_page_rule is removed rather than left dead. Loses points for a per-page cost introduced into ingest_page: a facility-wide WikiChunk scan (WHERE c.text CONTAINS '?db=') runs once per page (pipeline.py:1250), so ingest cost scales with pages x facility chunks, and mark_dynamic_handbook_pages re-embeds the identical stub once per chunk in the loop.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The node closes the prior review's blocking finding: detect_dynamic_page and the rule now run from the ingest path (pipeline.py:1250-1254 inside WikiIngestionPipeline.ingest_page) and from mark_dynamic_handbook_pages at the end of ingest_pages (pipeline.py:1557), so a fresh ingest marks a dynamic table with no operator call. A bounded live-graph read shows exactly three jt-60sa handbook table topics carry fronts_database - CategoryInformation ['EDDB','PMDB'], DataInformation ['UDDB','EQDB','FAME'], CategoryInformation2 ['LCDB','MBDB'] - covering all seven per-database tables. apply_dynamic_page_rule is deleted and fronts_databases_for_topic's unused facility_id is dropped at both call sites. Loses one point: the third topic keeps status 'skipped' rather than the plan's designed 'ingested' (finding 3).
